**No, it doesn't work yet.** Your Google account is not connected.

The ghealth CLI credentials loaded fine, and all 12 read-only Google Health permissions were granted. The verification call then failed with `ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED`, which means the Google credentials don't have a Google Health identity linked to them. The app can't read any data until that link exists.

Things to check:

- **Link the account:** Make sure the Google account you signed into with `ghealth` has Google Health set up and your health data linked to it. Then run `ghealth auth login` again and retry the connection.
- **Check which Google account is in use:** The CLI credentials may belong to a different Google account than the one that holds your Fitbit or Google Health data.
- **Token expiry:** The consent screen is in Testing mode, so refresh tokens expire after 7 days. If the credentials are old, a fresh `ghealth auth login` may be needed anyway.

If you can't get the API working, the fallback is `import_takeout`, which loads a Google Takeout or Fitbit export without API access. Tell me when you've re-run `ghealth auth login` and I'll try the connection again.
